rounds.recommendations: Mutation testing frameworks should perform static reachability analysis on kernel selection conditions before generating mutations in conditionally-executed code paths. For this codebase, mutations in `diag_matmul_kernel` are only testable when M < 1024, while mutations in `diag_matmul_kernel_optimized` require M >= 1024.
